summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Grupo Simec, S.A.B. de C.V., a Mexican steel producer, reporting its results of operations for the six-month period ended June 30, 2026. The filing contains no transaction, no special event, and no strategic action. It is a routine periodic earnings release that compares net sales, cost of sales, gross profit, EBITDA, and other financial metrics year-over-year. The document is purely operational and financial in nature. Accordingly, this filing does not qualify as a special situation under any category.
